entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Welcome to the Slot Room.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Here you will be playing a game that[n]requires you to match the patterns on[n]the rotating wheels.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're here to make money, not to play[n]your games!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: I am well aware of that.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Though to be perfectly honest... I've been[n]granted permission to kill every last one[n]of you here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears as though these interferences[n]are unavoidable. We must be ever-[n]vigilant.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, why didn't the guests around us[n]react to that battle?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It is probably due to Sae-san's perception[n]of the other people in the courtroom.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps as she sees it, they only care[n]for their own victory, while ignoring[n]the needs of others.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That reaction is certainly different from[n]what we saw on the lower floor.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder if that trend grows stronger[n]the higher up you go in the court system.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It is possible. In any case, we can now[n]freely access the Slot Room. We should[n]go look around.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Although I doubt we will find a fair fight[n]waiting for us in this scamming casino.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, is this the key?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wahoooo, let's take this and head back[n]to the control unit!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, it's and operation key!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perfect. Now we will be able to use[n]the control unit.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Look, it's an operation key!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now we can operate the control unit...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... I found the operation key!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Now we have four of them...[n]There's only one left!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh... I found an operation key.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This is our fifth and final one.[n]Let us head to the control unit.
